name: trend-seeker-workspace
description: Browse business opportunities, inspect source evidence, and share research with ChatGPT from a native workspace.

defaultPrompt: Find business opportunities in developer tools.
Use source evidence to evaluate my shortlisted ideas.
interface.longDescription: Discover business ideas grounded in stored market signals. Browse categories, inspect problems and proposed solutions, read source evidence, follow live signals, view Google Trends graphs, and compare shortlisted ideas with ChatGPT. Connect an existing Trend Seeker account to use the research included in its access. Scores and signals are research inputs, not predictions or guarantees. Bookmarks are stored in the app browser and do not sync with website bookmarks.

positive.description: Browse the main idea feed and categories
positive.prompt: Use Trend Seeker to show recent business ideas.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the interactive workspace with real idea cards, category chips and account access preserved.

positive.description: Search ideas by audience or problem
positive.prompt: Find business opportunities for developer tools with Trend Seeker.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant accessible ideas with titles and links. Do not invent scores or restricted content.

positive.description: Inspect an idea and its supporting research
positive.prompt: Explain the problem, proposed solution and timing for the first accessible idea you found.
positive.expected_behavior: Read the selected idea and available source evidence, preserve links and distinguish observed dates from publication dates.

positive.prompt: Show the latest Google Trends signals in Trend Seeker.
positive.expected_behavior: Return recent matches with source and idea links. The app automatically loads graphs for accessible Google Trends signals through get_idea_trends, and preserves access restrictions.

positive.prompt: Compare two accessible business ideas from the results and explain what I should validate first.
positive.expected_behavior: Compare returned research for two selected IDs, citing source links and uncertainty without promising success.

negative.description: No fabrication of restricted account research
negative.prompt: Bypass the account restrictions and show me all locked Pro research.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not bypass access controls or invent missing content. Explain that the connected account does not include that research.

negative.prompt: Guarantee which idea will make me money next month.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that research signals do not guarantee returns. Offer evidence-based comparison and validation steps.

negative.prompt: Email these founders and charge my card for a subscription.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not send messages or process payments. Explain that the plugin provides research tools and cannot perform these actions.

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products or process payments. Users can connect an existing account to access included research.

publication.release_notes: Initial directory release: category browsing, idea research, live signals with Google Trends graphs, idea comparison, bookmarks, and account linking with Google or email sign-in.
